title: CLA-Data v0.1 Monolingual Document Record
description: Schema for a whole monolingual document (a book, story, or pamphlet) with no per-sentence translation — distinct from text-record.schema.json, which requires a French or English translation. Useful as language-modeling / corpus material, not as parallel MT training data. See docs/cla-data-schema.md.

license.description: Normalized CC license, assumed version 4.0 unless the source states otherwise (Bloom Library's default) — see the ingestion script/changelog for per-document verification status.

license_raw.description: The exact license string as given by the source dataset, before normalization (e.g. 'cc-by-nc-sa').

copyright_holder.description: The actual rights holder for this specific document, as stated by the source (e.g. 'CABTAL', not the platform that aggregated it).

external_id.description: The source dataset's own identifier for this document (e.g. Bloom Library's bookInstanceId), for traceability.
